dedupe_keys.name: data augmentation to improve performance of neural networks for failure management in optical networks

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. A variational autoencoder generates synthetic training examples to reduce imbalance in an experimental optical-failure dataset. Neural networks then detect faults or identify their cause. The source reports training-time reductions of up to 37.1% and 60.6%, a 68% inference-complexity reduction and accuracy improvement up to 7.32%. Coverage is the stated optical-network classification experiment; these maxima are not universal guarantees. The shorter soft-failure paper describes the same augmentation result and is grouped as a companion. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The augmentation model supports training and evaluation of optical-network failure classifiers.
